title: Mobile Engineer III, iOS
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to the Team**  

The Expedia Group Payments team owns the Common Payment Module (CPM), the shared native library that powers checkout and payment capture across every Expedia Group brand's iOS and Android apps. We build the secure, high\-performance foundation that lets travellers save, select, and pay with their preferred payment method, seamlessly and reliably, at the single most business\-critical moment in the traveler journey.
  

We are looking for a native iOS engineer who is excited to contribute to the growth and evolution of the CPM platform by delivering impactful features and infrastructure that delight customers and partners while meeting the rigorous security and compliance bar payments demands. You will work in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment where ownership, technical excellence, and innovation are highly valued.
  

Team members on Payments are accountable for delivery and outcomes in a high\-impact environment. We embody the "One Team" philosophy and apply Agile, Lean, Continuous Delivery, and data\-driven principles across engineering and operations.
  

  

**In This Role, You Will:**

* Design, develop, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and related Apple frameworks, ensuring performant, reliable, and maintainable mobile experiences.
* Contribute to system design, including API contracts, low\-level design, and data modelling for mobile features that integrate with backend services and shared platforms.
* Implement high\-quality, testable code by applying engineering best practices in code structure, unit testing, integration testing, and code reviews within an agile development environment.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across multiple product areas or domains to deliver reusable mobile components and services that can be leveraged across Expedia Group brands.
* Diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in production and pre\-production environments, contributing to robust monitoring, logging, and operational excellence for iOS applications.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled or AI‑assisted solutions within mobile workflows, including familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.  
* 

  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in software development.
* Professional experience (typically 5\+ years) building and shipping native iOS applications using Swift, Xcode, and core iOS frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience owning features or services end\-to\-end within a mobile application, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Solid understanding of mobile system design fundamentals, including API design, data modelling, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization on iOS.
Demonstrated ability to work in a collaborative engineering environment, participating in code reviews, using source control, and following established engineering and operational practices.  
* 

  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving iOS application architectures (such as MVVM, VIPER, or similar patterns) and contributing to shared mobile platforms or libraries used across multiple teams or product areas.
* Background working with large\-scale consumer mobile applications, including performance tuning, offline capabilities, analytics integration, and experimentation to drive data\-informed improvements.
* Proven contribution to system and API design in partnership with backend and platform teams, including defining contracts, data schemas, and integration patterns for mobile clients.
* Experience safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions on mobile (for example, AI\-assisted search, recommendations, personalization, or content generation), with familiarity using AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows in product development.
* Exposure to or experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, monitoring, and alerting for iOS apps, with a focus on maintaining high reliability and operational excellence.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Application Developer-Mobile
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a **React Native Developer** with 3\-5 years of experience to design, develop, test, and deploy high\-quality mobile applications for **Android and iOS**. You will build user interface components, follow established React Native workflows and best practices, and publish apps to Google Play and the Apple App Store.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, maintain, and deploy mobile applications using the **React Native** framework
* Build reusable UI components and implement them following well\-known React Native workflows and practices
* Develop and maintain cross\-platform applications for **Android and iOS**
* Publish and manage app releases on **Google Play Store** and **Apple App Store**
* Integrate REST APIs and third\-party libraries
* Optimize app performance, responsiveness, and user experience
* Debug and resolve defects across devices and OS versions
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code
* Participate in code reviews and collaborate with designers, backend developers, and QA teams
* Work in an Agile/Scrum team

**Required Qualifications**

* **3\-5 years of experience** in mobile application development
* Strong hands\-on experience with **React Native**
* Proficiency in **JavaScript (ES6\+)** and/or **TypeScript**
* Experience developing **Android and iOS applications** and deploying them to **Google Play and the App Store**
* Experience building UI components and following React Native best practices
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs
* Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication and teamwork skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with state management (Redux, Context API, MobX)
* Knowledge of native modules and bridging (Java/Kotlin, Swift/Objective\-C)
* Experience with push notifications, deep linking, and app analytics
* Familiarity with mobile CI/CD tools (Fastlane, App Center, Bitrise, GitHub Actions)
* Experience with unit and end\-to\-end testing (Jest, Detox)
* Understanding of mobile security, authentication (OAuth, biometrics), and secure storage
* Knowledge of Firebase
* Banking or financial services app experience

**Tools \& Technologies**

* **Framework:** React Native, React
* **Languages:** JavaScript, TypeScript
* **Platforms:** Android, iOS, Google Play Console, App Store Connect
* **Tools:** Git, JIRA, Xcode, Android Studio
* **Testing \& CI/CD:** Jest, Detox, Fastlane

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Android Developer
description:
**Job Title: Android Developer with Kotlin and Jetpack**



About Us


*"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by* *Avtar \& Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*

*WHY JOIN CAPCO?*



You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.


*MAKE AN IMPACT*



Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.


*\#BEYOURSELFATWORK*



Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.


*CAREER ADVANCEMENT*


*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*


*DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION*


*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*


*Experience: 5\+ Years Work Mode: Hybrid (Work from Client Office)*

  



Key Responsibilities:



Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance Android applications using Kotlin and Java. Take ownership of features throughout the development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and production release. Contribute to application architecture, coding standards, and engineering best practices. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code while actively participating in code reviews. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including Product, Design, QA, and Backend Engineering, to deliver intuitive and user\-centric solutions. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and application stability issues.



Required Skills \& Experience



Strong hands\-on experience in Android application development using Kotlin and Java. Deep understanding of the Android SDK and modern Android development frameworks. Proficiency with Jetpack Components such as ViewModel, Room, LiveData, Navigation, and related libraries. Solid experience implementing MVVM and Clean Architecture principles. Strong knowledge of application security, secure coding practices, and compliance requirements. Experience with unit testing, code quality tools, and CI/CD practices is preferred. Excellent problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications Experience building enterprise\-grade or large\-scale mobile applications. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and collaborative development environments.



***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional software development or test automation engineering experience, including building and debugging applications and internal tools, with strength in at least one programming language and exposure to multiple technology implementations.
* Working knowledge of industry‑standard testing and monitoring tools for automated and distributed systems, and the ability to interpret system behavior and logs to perform effective RCA of failures.
* Ability to design and implement code and framework changes that improve stability, reliability, and test effectiveness across services or components, including familiarity with CI/CD workflows and observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing software, automation frameworks, or internal tools in at least two programming languages (such as Java and Python), including designing and maintaining test automation systems or high‑usage internal utilities from scratch.
* Proven ability to apply design patterns for scalable, maintainable systems and frameworks, including system design (low‑level design), API design, and data modeling for test and tooling platforms.
* Demonstrated impact in selecting appropriate technologies and architectures to solve business and quality needs, connecting team goals to broader business outcomes and identifying project‑level business problems with corresponding technical solutions.
* Familiarity with AI‑driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve test automation, developer workflows, or quality insights.
* Experience operating test automation and internal tooling at scale, including optimizing CI/CD pipelines, observability (Datadog, Splunk), and reliability for multi‑service or cross‑platform environments.
